title: Python: /groups/{id} GET/PUT/DELETE
close_reason: GET/PUT/DELETE /groups/{id} implemented as GroupsItemResource (PathCapable) sharing GroupsCollectionResource store. GET returns spec 18.8.1 document without master_secret; PUT updates name; DELETE returns 2.02 and drops local store. GET /groups list now matches 18.8.4 {groups:[{id,name,members}]}. pytest tests/coap/test_groups_item.py::test_group_item_get_put_delete and test_groups_collection.py passed.
